sources.name: TI BQ24074
sources.evidence: SLUS810N; layout p40, thermal p42, RGT0016C drawing PDF p53 and stencil p54. EP is main GND and must solder; under-paste vias may be filled/plugged/tented. Image of p53 reviewed.

sources.name: TI TPS63802
sources.evidence: SLVSEU9D. DLA0010A pad8 is broad PGND terminal, not an extra pad11. PDF p36/p37 visually reviewed: NSMD preferred, .10mm stencil, pad8 split aperture ~83%.
sources.evidence_mode: local cached primary document plus web verification

sources.name: ADI MAX17048
sources.evidence: Rev7; PDF p6 visually reviewed: exposed pad connected to GND. Do not apply module optional-EPAD rule.

sources.name: ADI MAX98357A
